title: Turning the Spell Around: Lightweight Alignment Amplification via Rank-One Safety Injection
abstract: arXiv:2508.20766v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Safety alignment in Large Language Models (LLMs) often involves mediating internal representations to refuse harmful requests. Recent research has demonstrated that these safety mechanisms can be bypassed by ablating or removing specific representational directions within the model. In this paper, we propose the opposite approach: Rank-One Safety Injection (ROSI), a white-box method that amplifies a model's safety alignment by permanently steering its activations toward the refusal-mediating subspace. ROSI operates as a simple, fine-tuning-free rank-one weight modification applied to all residual stream write matrices. The required safety direction can be computed from a small set of harmful and harmless instruction pairs. We show that ROSI consistently increases safety refusal rates - as evaluated by Llama Guard 3 - while preserving the utility of the model on standard benchmarks such as MMLU, HellaSwag, and Arc. translated_title: 反转魔咒：基于秩一安全注入的轻量级对齐增强
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）中的安全对齐通常通过调节内部表示来拒绝有害请求。近期研究表明，这些安全机制可以通过消融或移除模型内部特定的表示方向而被绕过。本文提出了相反的思路：秩一安全注入（ROSI），这是一种白盒方法，通过将模型激活永久性地引导至拒绝调节子空间来增强模型的安全对齐。ROSI 是一种简单、无需微调的秩一权重修改方法，应用于所有残差流写入矩阵。所需的安全方向仅需一小组有害与无害指令对即可计算得出。实验表明，ROSI 能够持续提升安全拒绝率（由 Llama Guard 3 评估），同时保持模型在 MMLU、HellaSwag 和 Arc 等标准基准上的性能表现。
tldr: 提出了一种无需微调的白盒方法 ROSI，通过对所有残差流写入矩阵进行秩一权重修改，将模型激活永久引导向拒绝子空间，从而低成本地增强大语言模型的安全对齐，同时不损害其通用能力。
en_tdlr: ROSI is a lightweight, fine-tuning-free white-box method that amplifies LLM safety alignment through a rank-one weight modification steering activations toward the refusal-mediating subspace, consistently improving safety refusal rates without degrading model utility.
